entries.title: Isaiah 47:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 God's judgment upon Babylon and Chaldea, 6 for their unmercifulness, 7 pride, 10 and overboldness, 11 shall be irresistible.

down. 3:26; 26:5; 52:2; Job 2:8,13; Ps 18:27; Jer 13:18; 48:18 La 2:10,21; Eze 26:16; 28:17; Ob 1:3,4; Jon 3:6 O virgin. 37:22; Jer 46:11 daughter. Ps 137:8; Jer 50:42; 51:33; Zec 2:7 there is. 14:13,14; Ps 89:44; Hag 2:22 thou shalt. 7-9; 32:9-11; De 28:56,57; La 4:5; Re 18:7

entries.title: Isaiah 47:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
silent. 13:20; 14:23; 1Sa 2:9; Ps 31:17; 46:10; Jer 25:10; La 1:1; Hab 2:20 Zec 2:13; Mt 22:12,13; Jude 1:13; Re 18:21-24 for.After Babylon was taken by Cyrus, instead of being "the lady of kingdoms," the metropolis of a great empire, and mistress of all the East, it became subject to the Persians; and the imperial seat being removed to Susa, instead of having a king, it had only a deputy residing there, who governed it as a province of the Persian empire.

7; 13:19; 14:4; Da 2:37,38; Re 17:3-5,18; 18:7,16-19

entries.title: Isaiah 47:10
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: thou hast trusted. 28:15; 59:4; Ps 52:7; 62:9 thou hast said. 29:15; Job 22:13,14; Ps 10:11; 64:5; 94:7-9; Ec 8:8; Jer 23:24 Eze 8:12; 9:9 Thy wisdom. 5:21; Eze 28:2-6; Ro 1:22; 1Co 1:19-21; 3:19 perverted thee. or, caused thee to turn away. I am. 8

entries.title: Isaiah 47:11
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: thou shalt not know. 37:36; Ex 12:29,30; Ne 4:11; Re 3:3 from whence it riseth. Heb. the morning thereof. thou shaltnot be. Ps 50:22; Jer 51:39-42; Da 5:25-30; 1Th 5:3; Re 18:9,10 put it off. Heb. expiate. Mt 18:34; Lu 12:59

entries.title: Isaiah 47:13
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: wearied. 57:10; Eze 24:12; Hab 2:13 Let now. 44:25; Da 2:2-10; 5:7,8,15,16,30 astrologers, the stargazers. Heb. viewers of the heavens.the monthly prognosticators. Heb. that gave knowledge concerning the months.

entries.title: Isaiah 47:14
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: they shall. 40:24; 41:2; Eze 15:7; Ps 83:13-15; Joe 2:5; Ob 1:18; Na 1:10; Mal 4:1 themselves Heb. their souls. Mt 10:28; 16:26 there shall. 30:14; Jer 51:25,26; Re 18:21

entries.title: Isaiah 47:15
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
thy merchants. 56:11; Eze 27:12-25; Re 18:11-19 they shall.Babylon was replenished from all nations, by a concourse of people, whom Jeremiah (ch. 50:37) calls "the mingled people." All these, at the approach of Cyrus, sought to escape to their several countries.

Jer 51:6-9; Re 18:15-17
